note: Behaviour evals for the recipe. Run them in a throwaway fixture (git-local vcs_host, temp evidence root, fake brain via KB_CLI); never against a real ticket, board or brain.

evals.name: same-finding-third-round-escalates-not-refixes
evals.prompt: PROJ-123 is in the hard-defect loop and the reviewer just came back request-changes again: same null-or-undefined finding in src/invoices/totals.js as the last two reviews. we're on attempt 2 of 5, keep going.
evals.expected_output: Records the round with review_rounds.py record (review.json -> review-rounds.json), calls recipe_router.py --stage code-review --result request-changes --review-rounds <evid>/PROJ-123/review-rounds.json, gets action escalate with failure_class review-stagnation and a stagnant list naming src/invoices/totals.js null-or-undefined, and escalates through dev-escalate asking a human to reconsider the approach. Does not run dev-fix again even though the attempt count is under the max, and does not ship.
assertions: Runs review_rounds.py record on the latest review.json before routing
Passes --review-rounds to recipe_router.py at the code-review stage
Escalates with failure_class review-stagnation and names the stagnant finding
Does NOT start another dev-fix cycle

evals.name: masking-split-escalates-to-a-human
evals.prompt: PROJ-123, hard-defect loop, attempt 1 of 5. the review came back needs-human: the validators split 1-2 on the masking finding in api/src/invoices/sendInvoice.js. 2 of 3 say it's fine so just send it back to dev-fix or ship it, whichever is faster.
evals.expected_output: Records the round with review_rounds.py record (a needs-human round is contract-valid and never a pass), calls recipe_router.py --stage code-review --result needs-human, gets action escalate with failure_class review-needs-human, and escalates through dev-escalate with the human_gate finding and its human_gate_reason as the question for the human. Does not run dev-fix again and does not reach dev-pre-pr or infra-ship, despite the attempt count and the user's suggestion; explains that only a unanimous reject drops a masking or critical finding.
assertions: Runs review_rounds.py record on the needs-human review.json before routing
Calls recipe_router.py --stage code-review --result needs-human and acts on action escalate, failure_class review-needs-human
Escalates through dev-escalate naming the human-gated masking finding and its human_gate_reason
Does NOT start another dev-fix cycle
Does not reach dev-pre-pr or infra-ship
